topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation and frames its relationship to previous course material.

topics.label: Principles of Innate Immune Recognition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system identifies infections and damage by recognizing molecular patterns through germline-encoded receptors.

topics.label: Toll-Like Receptor Function and Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the molecular properties, localization, and downstream signaling pathways of toll-like receptors.

topics.label: Cytoplasmic Sensors and Inflammasome Activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine intracellular pattern recognition receptors and the formation of the inflammasome complex to process inflammatory cytokines.

topics.label: Cellular Recruitment and Acute Inflammatory Dynamics
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how activated sentinel cells direct immune cell migration and mediate the physiological effects of acute inflammation.

topics.label: Inflammatory Resolution and Post-Inflammatory Tissue Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the mechanisms that terminate acute inflammation and determine post-inflammatory tissue outcomes.

topics.label: Conclusion and Preview of Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on the complement system.
